REST API serializers for the news application. Making approved read-only prevents a journalist from approving an article through crafted JSON.

news.services module¶

Business services for article approval and notifications.

Using an explicit service is safer than sending email from a generic post_save signal because approval is a business action.

news.services.approve_article(article)¶

Approve an article and send one subscriber notification.

news.services.notify_article_subscribers(article)¶

Email readers subscribed to the article’s source.
